Package CPDFGeneration

Class CEmailResult

java.lang.Object
CPDFGeneration.CEmailResult
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class CEmailResult extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Owns a native result, including results representing failed conversions. Always close, preferably with try-with-resources. Same-result operations are serialized, close is idempotent, and native access after close is rejected. Returned metadata, HTML and byte arrays are owned Java copies.

The status and diagnostics describe the most recent conversion or native output operation. Each HTML export or PDF write recomputes them from the initial HTML conversion state. PDF, license or output failures may leave HTML and attachments available for a later export or retry; input parsing failures do not guarantee that content exists. Java validation failures do not start a native output operation.

The original cancellation callback is retained until close and is reused for later output operations. Callbacks must not reenter email APIs, close this result or release converter properties. The wrapper rejects reentry on the current thread with IllegalStateException.

Since:
1.3.0

    • close

      public void close()

      public CEmailStatus ExportHtml(String directory)

    • WritePdf

      public CEmailStatus WritePdf(String path, CConverterProperties properties)
      Render existing HTML to a new PDF, allowing retries after PDF/license/output failures. Requires a valid initialized license. Existing files are preserved; a partial file created by this operation is removed on failure. The original cancellation callback remains active.

      Null properties select A4 with top/bottom margins of 32 CSS pixels and left/right margins of 40 CSS pixels. Supplied properties preserve all caller margins, including zero, and are not modified. Keep properties and their font provider valid and unchanged during this call. Attachments are not embedded in the PDF or rendered as extra pages.

      Parameters:
      path - new PDF path, encoded as UTF-8
      properties - borrowed PDF properties, or null for default email page properties
      Returns:
      write status; also updates GetStatus() and current diagnostics
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the path contains NUL
      IllegalStateException - if the result is closed, properties have been released, or this method is called reentrantly from an email callback

    • WritePdf

      public CEmailStatus WritePdf(OutputStream output, CConverterProperties properties)
      Render existing HTML to a caller-owned PDF stream with a valid license. The stream is neither closed nor flushed. Discard partial bytes on failure or cancellation; Java output exceptions are retained by GetLastCallbackException(). The original cancellation callback applies. Uses the same page-property and attachment rules as WritePdf(String, CConverterProperties).
      Parameters:
      output - caller-owned PDF output stream
      properties - borrowed PDF properties, or null for default email page properties
      Returns:
      write status; also updates the result status and diagnostics
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the result is closed, properties have been released, or this method is called reentrantly from an email callback
